test_cases.summary:
Verify Page loads with header and controls
when the user opens the Session Label page
test_cases.description:
Feature: Session Label Page Management
Scenario: Page loads with header and controls
Given the user opens the Session Label page
When the page finishes loading
Then header, search field, Create button, and label table should be visible
test_cases.acceptance:
Header, search field, Create button, and label table should be visible
The behavior should be validated when the page finishes loading.

test_cases.summary:
Verify Label data loads on page access
when labels exist in the system
test_cases.description:
Feature: Session Label Page Management
Scenario: Label data loads on page access
Given labels exist in the system
When the page loads
Then the table should display all existing labels
test_cases.acceptance:
The table should display all existing labels
The behavior should be validated when the page loads.

test_cases.summary:
Verify Search filters labels
when multiple labels are present
test_cases.description:
Feature: Session Label Page Management
Scenario: Search filters labels
Given multiple labels are present
When the user enters text in the search field
Then the table should display only matching labels
test_cases.acceptance:
The table should display only matching labels
The behavior should be validated when the user enters text in the search field.

test_cases.summary:
Verify Clear search restores full data
when search results are filtered
test_cases.description:
Feature: Session Label Page Management
Scenario: Clear search restores full data
Given search results are filtered
When the user clears the search field
Then all labels should be displayed again
test_cases.acceptance:
All labels should be displayed again
The behavior should be validated when the user clears the search field.

test_cases.acceptance:

when labels exist

The behavior should be validated when data cannot be loaded.
